summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend regression for parent Supplier GHG Logs/View mode on live preview. Verified 7-column logs without standalone Evidence column, paperclip icon behavior in Category, parent detail mapping payload + evidence redaction, read-only lock behavior, and auth guard on parent detail endpoint.

issues: Console shows React invalid DOM nesting/hydration errors (`<span>` rendered inside `<select>/<option>`) when opening View Emission dialog.

action_items: Fix invalid DOM nesting in read-only emission dialog render path to remove hydration/runtime console errors.
Optional hardening: add explicit data-testid hooks for dynamic-field labels inside read-only dialog to make UI parity assertions deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: EmissionEditForm.jsx remains very large (~1500+ lines), increasing regression surface for read-only vs edit-mode behavior; further modular split is recommended.
seed_data_creation: None. No test data created or persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scope 2 and Fugitive parent-visible samples were present and validated for mapping-label parity against input_field_mappings via live detail payload + UI dialog text. Logs showed 20 rows in tested period with both evidence and non-evidence rows visible. Supplier/non-admin access restriction to parent detail endpoint validated in backend tests.
rca of the issue: Console hydration errors originate from invalid DOM structure in read-only dialog rendering path (nested span wrappers around option/select content). Functional flow still works, but this can cause unstable UI behavior and noisy runtime logs.
